hostingRules: Use real project assets/GitHub import or durable HTTPS file hosting with verified media URLs. No fabricated cloud/public URLs.
Use ordinary direct media/PDF URLs for the learner; model URL-context reading is a different feature.
Google Drive sharing page is not a guaranteed audio streaming URL; test actual access signed out, content type, redirects and mobile playback.
Test byte-range support for large media seeking, CORS for fetch/visualization, inline PDF fallback; download behavior depends on browser and host.
Do not pass signed expiring links off as permanent URLs. Private data must not use public media bucket.
Cloudflare Pages max single asset 25 MiB; larger original PDFs need a suitable other host.
Do not attach ZIPs/large binaries to Build chat without verified support for that exact interface. Project ZIP export is not proof of chat ZIP import.
Keep remoteUrl null until a real URL is configured; mark asset missing, not imported.
